packages.label: רֶגֶל — הַמַּדְרֵגוֹת הַתַּחְתּוֹנוֹת
packages.reason: All these concepts share the essential nature of 'רֶגֶל' (foot/lowest level). The Rebbe explicitly calls each one a 'bechina of foot': נצח והוד are the feet of the sefirotic body and are the bechina of prophets; a wife (אשה) is called רגל; faith (אמונה) is called רגל; evil speech (דבור הרע) is called רגל; money (ממון) is called רגל; all lower spiritual gradations (כל המדרגות התחתונות) go by the name 'feet'; a son (ברא) is the כרעא (Aramaic: foot/leg) of his father. All share the same structural position in their respective domains — the bottom, the outermost extension, the lowest gradation — yet all are capable of being elevated through joy of Torah and mitzvah. The metaphor cuts across human relationships (wife, son), spiritual faculties (faith), ethical behavior (speech), material life (money), and Kabbalistic anatomy (netzach and hod). The neutral polarity reflects that this cluster includes both positive elements (faith, prophets, wife, son) and negative elements (evil speech), unified by their common structural identity as 'foot.'

merge_notes.reason: The Talmudic dictum 'ברא כרעא דאבוה' (Eruvin 70b) — a son is the foot/leg of his father — is a bechina statement: the son and the foot share the same essential nature of being the continuation and extension of what came before. The proof text places this directly in the list of things called 'רגל.' Since ברא (son) IS a כרעא (foot) in the same sense all other items in this Torah are called רגל, this pair merges into the central רגל cluster. The relationship is bechina (shared nature), not eitza.

packages.label: צֶדֶק וְתוֹרָה — אוֹת הֵ"א
packages.label_en: Righteousness and Torah — The Letter Heh
packages.reason: These three concepts share the same essential holy nature: Torah and mitzvah (תורה והמצוה) ARE righteousness (צדק) — the Rebbe proves this from multiple verses ('כי כל מצותיך צדק'). Righteousness (צדק) IS the letter Heh (אות הא) — the Rebbe states that the wife is connected 'לבחינת צדק, הנקרא הא,' linking צדק to the letter Heh which is associated with the Shekhinah/malkhut. Furthermore, the supporters of Torah (תומכי דאוריתא) ARE called pillars of truth (סמכי קשוט) — this bechina pair is merged here because they belong to the same domain of Torah/mitzvah/righteousness, and the word 'קשוט' (truth/righteousness) directly connects them to the צדק theme. Together, this package defines the positive force of the teaching: Torah and mitzvah in their essential nature are righteousness, and righteousness is identified with the divine letter Heh (the Shekhinah). This is the 'good' pole of the Torah — the force that elevates all the 'lower levels.'

merge_notes.reason: The Rebbe states that when one learns Torah with joy that reaches the feet, the 'תומכי דאוריתא' (supporters of Torah) are elevated — they are called 'סמכי קשוט' (pillars of truth/righteousness). This is a pure bechina: supporters of Torah and pillars of truth are two names for the same thing. They merge into Package 2 (the Torah/Tzedek cluster) because 'קשוט' (Aramaic: truth/righteousness) is semantically equivalent to 'צדק,' placing them squarely in the righteousness domain. Their elevation through Torah joy does not describe a cause-effect from a different package; rather, it names what they already essentially are. The connection is bechina (shared nature), not eitza.
